title: Pre-Form One course 2026: registration is open
body:
Pre-Form One course 2026: school registration is now open, from 14 September to 15 December 2026.

Fees listed on the school's poster: day students (kutwa) TZS 150,000; boarding (bweni) TZS 250,000. The poster also lists free transport (usafiri bure) and free meals (chakula bure).

Contact the school on +255 654 995 711 or +255 754 309 879. Address: Mbezi Kimara kwa Msuguri, Dar es Salaam.
excerpt: Registration runs from 14 September to 15 December 2026.

title: Form 5 admission 2026
body:
Form 5 admission 2026: the school is accepting applications for Form Five. This opportunity is open only to students who achieved Division I or Division II in Form Four.

Contact us on +255 754 309 879 or +255 654 995 711.
excerpt: Applications are open to students who achieved Division I or II in Form Four.
